operation.description:
Sets the GitHub Actions permissions policy for repositories and allowed actions and reusable workflows in an organization.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `admin:org` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: Set GitHub Actions permissions for an organization

#/components/parameters/org.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/org.name: org

#/components/schemas/allowed-actions.description: The permissions policy that controls the actions and reusable workflows that are allowed to run.

#/components/schemas/enabled-repositorie.description: The policy that controls the repositories in the organization that are allowed to run GitHub Actions.

#/components/schemas/sha-pinning-require.description: Whether actions must be pinned to a full-length commit SHA.
